prior_result: Minimal trace reproduced canvas focus failure in all three repetitions: X11 focus remains on the active editor, explicit focused state remains on the object list/Image row and Space does not open Layout.
hypothesis: The batched End, Home, Down, Down, Down sequence temporarily selects the requested final group at End. The title predicate can therefore return before later queued navigation events are consumed; those events can reclaim focus after GrabFocus.
changed_method: Pair the same sequence with and without a fresh expected title acknowledgement after each key. Record title reads and sent-key timestamps without adding native reads. Require explicit focused state and actual keyboard activation of Layout. Use positive showing/modal-state observations at dialog boundaries.
decision: An ordered pass with batched failures and transient group-title observations supports an input-ordering cause. Keep all acceptance deadlines and postconditions fixed. Do not infer earlier unrelated focus/interface causes or weaken accessibility assertions.
